evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament fibers are intact with mucoid degenerative changes.
evidence.MCL: Posterior cruciate, medial collateral and the remainder of the lateral collateral ligamentous complex, including the femoral lateral collateral ligament, iliotibial band, popliteus and biceps femoris tendons, are intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus posterior horn radial oblique tear.
evidence.Medial OA: Articular cartilage of the medial femoral condyle is intact.
evidence.Lateral OA: Articular cartilage of the lateral femoral condyle is mildly thinned.
evidence.PF OA: Moderate to severe chondromalacia of the medial trochlear cartilage
evidence.Fracture: remainder of the bone marrow signal appears normal
